Hi team!

:party_blob:*Today is a huge milestone –* _*SaySo is officially in the App Store*_! :party_blob:We have a real, live app that people can download _right now_. That includes YOU :eyes:– click <https://apps.apple.com/us/app/sayso-news/id6748095552|this link> on your phone and tap “GET” to update to the OFFICIAL version of SaySo! (That’s it! There’s no need to delete the old version)

What we’ve shipped in under a year is honestly…kind of wild! We’re talking about a fully functioning, multi-sided platform with content, creators, moderation, and a brand new home page design coming very soon.

*It was a big XFN effort to get here, but I want to give a special shout out to the dev team*. Thank you to <@U05BV05GYQH> <@U06JQHRF6HJ> <@U06TP3HRUKV> <@U09FVDA7NEQ> and <@U08SFKMBSMR> for getting us to a place where we can actually put this in people’s hands. :clap::clap::clap:

*What happens next:*
• *`No more TestFlight.`* Anyone with the link can download SaySo.
• *`We are live, but _unlisted._`* The app won’t show up in App Store search just yet – you need the direct link to get it. This gives us control while we build the right audience and momentum as we go to market.
• *`The waitlist is still on for now`.* New users will be on a waitlist for a short period. We’ll start onboarding in waves beginning the week of *March 2*, with plans to phase out the waitlist at the end of the month.
• *`Creators start promoting the app this week.`* They’ll be sharing the App Store link in our first wave of marketing to build buzz and a deeper waitlist roster.
This is a big day, but it’s also just the beginning. We now get to see how real users behave, what sticks, what breaks, what surprises us, and start tightening everything ahead of full launch. More to come soon!

My team is attending two events 5,000 miles apart this week. 

Starting today, our founder & CEO, Ramin Beheshti, will be in Vail, Colorado for the Digiday Publishing Summit leading a panel on how Caliber has built a next-gen publisher that leans into creators, at a time when competition for attention has never been higher, and orgs are needing to compete with (or in our case, embrace) the creator economy. The panel will be on Wednesday 3/25 at 9:45am - it's can't miss. 

Even more, with AI creeping into every corner of our work, Ramin brings a unique, technological expertise to the table from his past work leading product & tech at Dow Jones - a great person to speak to on all things AI and future of publishing (or his Liverpool fandom), even outside of his creator-focused panel. 

Changing gears...on the other side of the Atlantic, we've got Will Hamnett and Scott B. bopping around Advertising Week Europe in London. They'll be at the event meeting with partners and friends, new and old, but you can also find them at **Daly's Wine Bar at 5pm** on Tuesday 2/24 for a hang and chat on the new landscape of media partnerships, sales and growth. Two guys I respect a ton, who have been around the block and have a lot to share. 

If you're in either of these places, drop me a line (or message them on LI directly) and we can get you set-up for a coffee, a pint, or just a chat.

hello everyone - as our beloved <@U07905C76T1> leaves the Caliber shores, we are seeking to gauge interest from people in getting involved in an initiative that I think we can all agree has helped us level up from a cultural perspective, and definitely from a cocktail perspective.

after today, we will have four current members of the Culture Corner - myself, <@U06TRLR09CL>, <@U08KBD1JJJ3>, <@U04MJGQ6KU5> - which makes it a little bit of a stretch for those of us involved, and we would love for people who are keen to get involved to let us know.

It’s that time again where we ask you to reflect on the work you’ve done during the first trimester - thinking about the impact you’ve had in your role, how you’ve performed against our values, and your own personal growth and development.

As part of this, we’ll also ask you to take part in our 360 reviews. You’ll be asked to select up to five people to provide feedback on your performance, specifically how you collaborate and influence across Caliber. Please make sure your manager agrees with your selection and if not, work together to agree on a final list.

The questions we’ll be asking this time are:
• How does this person positively influence the people or projects around them?
• When this person faces disagreement or challenge, how do they typically respond?
• What’s one behaviour or habit that would elevate their leadership impact across the team?
360 reviews will be open from *Monday 13th April to Monday 5th May*. The link is here:

<https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdcro0SA6Ip-ViB_r91VlSUtgjLGg2p6N-XXSPNtgHegJYsEw/viewform?usp=publish-editor>

We’ll be running calibration on *20th May*. We know this is slightly later than usual. This means your rating, along with any promotion decisions, will be confirmed following this date.

Calibration is where xCaliber comes together to review and discuss ratings, ensuring alignment on expectations for employees at every level. This ensures performance is assessed fairly, consistently, and equitably across all teams.

If you’re a manager

Sit down with your team members to reflect on the last trimester. Together, assess what has worked well and what hasn’t, using our performance framework:
• Impact in role - this will now account for 60% of the rating 
• Personal growth and development - this accounts for 15% of the rating 
• How someone shows up (our values) - Accounts for 25% of the rating 
Please do not confirm ratings with your team members until calibration has taken place.
From *1st May*, you should begin setting new goals with your team, aligned to our KPIs for the next trimester. We will assess progress against the objectives set during calibration so it’s crucial these are set and reviewed. Without these, we have no evidence to back any rating proposed.

If you’re a team member

Come prepared for your review conversation. Think about:
• Where you’ve had the most impact
• Where you need support
• What development you’d like to focus on next
Everyone

Be candid and kind. Base your feedback on your own experience, not group opinion, and approach every conversation with positive intent.
You can find our performance guide here:

<https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1hhTNulhfPPGqWAsrrz_BB7HiaiFJvT0xDvgz_HIcbTQ/edit?usp=sharing>

We’ve also moved to a simpler rating scale, aligned with our incentive plans:
• Room for improvement
• Progressing
• Rock star
• Superstar
Performance drop-in sessions

Designed to walk you through the process, these will be scheduled from *20th - 23rd April* and will run at times convenient for everyone. Should none of the dates work please drop me a note and I’ll happily walk you through the process or answer any questions you might have.

L

Hello all!

We have a quick Ops update for you.

To help us work faster and smarter, we’re launching a new Slack channel: <#C0ALFJ29UF4> next week for you lovely lot to use when you need our help.

- It keeps everything in one place, turns requests into trackable tasks, and helps us prioritise so nothing falls through the cracks.

- What you need
- Brief context
- Deadline (date)
- People to loop in

We know this is an adjustment and will take some getting used to. Thanks,
Luce, Oreal & Shapla :raised_hands::skin-tone-2:
